description:
Activate Altar of Dementia by sacrificing Trapjaw Kelpie
When Trapjaw Kelpie dies, its persist ability triggers, returning it from your graveyard to the battlefield with a -1/-1 counter on it.
When Trapjaw Kelpie enters, Stalwart Successor triggers, putting a +1/+1 counter on Trapjaw Kelpie
Resolve the Altar of Dementia ability.
Repeat.
